programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: Top salvage expert Drew Pritchard breaks new ground with his first ever buying trip to Northern Ireland, where he gets trollied and falls for a vintage Japanese beauty.

programs.title: Tanked
programs.desc: Wayde and Brett build a giant bar aquarium for the owners of Creek Casino in Alabama. This tank marks ATM's 10,000th tank and is one of the largest they've ever built.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers
programs.desc: Mike and Elvis attempt to resuscitate the 'daddy' of British executive saloons: a 1974 Jaguar XJ6. But it's a risky buy: it hasn't been on the road since 1990!

programs.title: Texas Metal
programs.desc: In one of the shop's most intricate metal projects, Bill and his team hand make an engine bay for the '68 GTO out of steel and aluminum.

programs.title: Shorty's Dream Shop
programs.desc: Work continues on the Volkswagen delivery bus, as Shorty gets down in the paint booth on this giant beast.

programs.title: Iron Resurrection
programs.desc: A 1956 Ford truck has been sitting in the barn for more than three decades. Joe and the team fix up this neglected vehicle with a hand-built custom frame.
